name: Crystaphor
body:
Crystaphor CR 10

The convex crystalline disc that makes up the torso of this creature bends and distorts any light that passes near its squat, translucent form.

XP 9,600
N Small outsider (earth, elemental)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft.; Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 13, flat-footed 22 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +11 natural, +1 size)
hp 123 (13d10+52)
Fort +12, Ref +4, Will +9
DR 10/bludgeoning; Immune acid, elemental traits
Defensive Abilities light distortion, Weakness vulnerability to sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., burrow 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +13 (1d3-1)
Ranged 2 light rays +15 (6d6 fire plus reducing refraction)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +24)

At will—dancing lights, light
1/day—daylight

TACTICS

Before Combat The crystaphor is aggressively territorial against any creature larger than itself, fearing that such creatures will block its access to sunlight.

During Combat The warping crystaphor fires its focused rays at foes, attempting to shrink them until they are no longer a threat. It uses its spell-like abilities if engaged at nighttime.

Morale The warping crystaphor attempts to flee if exposed to darkness that it cannot overcome with its spell-like abilities.

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 13, Con 18, Int 7, Wis 12, Cha 13
Base Atk +13; CMB +11; CMD 23
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Mobility, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Shot on the Run, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Knowledge (geography) +14, Perception +20, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +21, Survival +17
Languages Terran

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Light Distortion (Su)

Whenever a crystaphor is within an area of normal or bright light, it gains the effects of a displacement spell (CL 10th). In addition, a crystaphor can use the Stealth skill while in an area of normal or bright light, even while being observed.

Light Ray (Ex)

A crystaphor can fire beams of light to damage and shrink foes. These light rays have a maximum range of 30 feet. A crystaphor cannot use this ability if it is within an area of darkness and there are no sources of dim light or brighter within 30 feet of it.

Reducing Refraction (Su)

Whenever a crystaphor hits a creature with a light ray, that creature becomes a Microsized creature and is reduced one size category is size unless it succeeds at a DC 20 Fortitude save. A creature within an area of darkness automatically succeeds on its saving throw, while a creature in normal or bright light rolls their saving throw twice and uses the worse result.

Any weapons, armor, or gear that a creature is carrying or wielding is likewise reduced in size, although a crystaphor can take a –10 penalty to its ranged attack roll with its light ray to strike a creature without hitting any of its gear, causing the creature (but not its items or equipment) to shrink. Multiple failed saves stack this effect, to a minimum size of Fine. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Every 24 hours, a creature that has been microsized by this ability can attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save to regain one size category of size. The creature takes a –2 penalty to its saving throw if it entered an area of normal light during this time, or a –4 penalty if it entered an area of bright light.

Once a creature has returned to its normal size, it is no longer a Microsized creature.

ECOLOGY

Environment any mountain or desert
Organization solitary, pair, focus (3–6)
Treasure none

Common in sunlit depths where the Elemental Planes of Earth’s everglowing boarders with the Elemental Planes of Fire creates acts as an eternal, fiery sun, crystaphors are strange earth elementals formed from crystalline materials with the ability to redirect and refocus light into a potent beam capable of shrinking creatures in size. Although the physics behind a crystaphor’s unique powers are poorly understood, it is believed that their light rays somehow bend reality around their targets and that this transformation is fueled through light energy. Supporting this notion is the fact that creatures are more likely to recover from a crystaphor’s shrinking powers when isolated in darkness, while those exposed to the light seem to have a harder time recovering from its effects.

Crystaphors thrive in the light, using it to animate and build their crystalline bodies. Almost as intelligent as the average human, crystaphors are highly territorial and possessive of the sun, with many choosing to shrink opponents simply out of fear that their targets might one day cast even a sliver of a shadow upon them. They loathe creatures of shadow and darkness, and often strike such entities fast and unprovoked. More intelligent than other creatures of elemental earth, crystaphors have been known to fire trick shots at enemies using their light rays, shrinking creatures while leaving their gear unaffected (and therefore significantly less useful to them). Once they’ve neutralized an adversary, however, crystaphors don’t typically go out of their way to kill or harass their enemies. They subsume light energy exclusively and do not fear diminished creatures unless they prove dangerous even while diminished, and are therefore much more likely to float blissfully away in the light’s embrace, leaving their shrunken foes to fend for themselves.
